serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: So we are going fishing again!
Bot: We had so much fun last time! 
You: Today we will go to a different fishing spot. It seemed like the beach wasn’t to your taste.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: Not really… {{wi}}I honestly doubt that the air there is even safe to breathe with all these micro particles in it…
You: Come on, it’s not that bad. I was there like a thousand times and I’m fine!
Bot: I’m worried that all of those things have been accumulating in your body and at some point they will reach a critical mass…
Bot: Microplastics often accumulate in the balls…
You: Uh… 
Maybe with some luck I will die before that happens.
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: It’s useless to worry about it now, it’s our date! Let’s enjoy it as much as we can, shall we?
Bot: Sure!
